tasks.title: Enforce discovery radius and add Claude approach coach
tasks.brief:
Implement server changes only. New Profile fields (Codex owns lib/network.ts): visibilityKm:number default1.6 allowed0.8,1.6,4.8,8,16.1; meetingStyle:Either|In person|Online defaultEither; experience:Student|Early career|Experienced defaultStudent; availability:Now|This week|Flexible defaultFlexible; photoUrl:string defaultempty (allow HTTPS URL or data:image/jpeg/png/webp;base64, max180000 chars, no SVG); socials object linkedin/instagram/github defaultempty strings, allow only exact provider domains and subdomains for HTTPS URLs; onboardingVersion:number default1 existing but UI saves2. Keep old profiles compatible. GET profile merge defaults. Discover live requests require valid latitude/longitude search query parameters, rounded to coarse center; exclude targets when distance from supplied search area exceeds target visibilityKm (default1.6). Return optional new fields for people. Explain this bounds search area, not proof of physical position. Reuse radius availability policy for new requests, icebreaker, and coach based on body latitude/longitude; demo IDs exempt from radius. Keep bilateral blocks/expiry checks. POST coach accepts personId and <=12 user/assistant messages each <=1200 chars and latitude/longitude. Uses shared daily20-call quota with icebreaker. Server-side Anthropic Messages API only; system prompt coaches respectful specific introductions with no invented relationships, no sending messages, no scraping socials. Pass only sender name/goal/preferences and target name/role/company/help/goal; do not send photo URLs, socials, location, or user IDs. Return text/source/note. Missing key or timeout/upstream error returns useful labeled template guidance. GET coach returns configured boolean only, never key. Refactor shared AI helper if useful. Do not edit lib/network, UI, schema, package, notes except your report, deploy or push. Add meaningful policy/schema tests. Run tests and typecheck once Codex types exist. Report path knowledge/bridge/reports/preferences-coach-api.md.
Follow-up from claude: Apply Codex integration feedback: default model claude-sonnet-5-5, coach reply <=1200 chars, remove fallbacks/beta settings.
